BiblicalUsage: Sheshbazzar is the prince of Judah to whom Cyrus gives the vessels of the house of God, and who lays the foundation of the temple when the exiles return. Ezra names him governor, and the elders say he came and laid the foundations.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sheshbazzar is the man who carries the gold home and lays the first stone, and the temple starts with him. I hold that the foundation matters more than the finish, because without it there is nothing to build on.
